verdict.rationale: Qodo documents its own natural-language chat inside pull requests, where users can discuss findings and remediate them with a Chat Agent. Its Agentic Toolbox exposes Qodo skills to coding agents such as Claude, which users drive with natural-language prompts. Natural-language control is scoped to PR review and finding resolution; configuration, rules and governance run through the portal or a .pr_agent.toml file. Missing for 10: natural-language operation of configuration, rules and governance; documentation of chat command depth; independent hands-on corroboration of the PR chat experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Chat with Qodo to interact with Qodo directly inside pull requests.
Use Fix with Chat Agent to remediate issues while you chat with Qodo.
Use Qodo with Claude to access Qodo Agentic Toolbox skills for understanding your codebase, reviewing changes, and resolving code review findings.
